meta.brief: 30 homepage design directions + competitor landscape. Preserve Angel Face equity; lead with ultrasound, regenerative, natural results, Stoneham priority.
suggestions: Lead homepage with ultrasound mapping + regenerative consult (not a discount banner).
Put Jenny front-and-center with RN credentials and training (Switzerland / NYC / ultrasound).
Make Stoneham the primary CTA location; Boston secondary.
Add a first-timer calm path — reviews already prove this is a strength.
Mobile sticky Book + text-Jenny concierge (patients already text).
Service mega-menu: Neuromodulators / Fillers / Regenerative / Early adopter.
Do not hard-cut rebrand; keep Angel Face searchable for 6+ months.
Steal structure from Precision Nurse (founder + Book Now) but differentiate on ultrasound rarity.
Avoid deal-spa promo grids used by chain clinics (LaserAway / VIO).
Publish education content that beats Seaport recognition-badge noise with substance.

competitors.name: Precision Nurse Aesthetics
competitors.siteTake: Clean founder-forward site, strong Book Now, PDGF called out, dual locations clear.
competitors.suggestion: Mirror their clarity and founder page — then beat them with ultrasound-guided story Angel Face owns.

competitors.name: Cosmetic Laser Solutions
competitors.siteTake: Device-heavy clinical language; lasers/RF/ultrasound systems as hero.
competitors.suggestion: Do not compete on device inventory. Compete on injector skill + facial ultrasound for injectables safety.

competitors.name: Seaport Medspa
competitors.siteTake: Polished multi-location brand, Top % vendor badges, commission-free messaging.
competitors.suggestion: You cannot out-badge them. Out-personalize them: Jenny-named reviews + education depth.

competitors.name: Newton Medical Aesthetics
competitors.siteTake: Physician-led boutique luxury; refined natural-beauty copy.
competitors.suggestion: Borrow their elevated tone for premium pricing posture without pretending MD-owned.

competitors.name: Boemy Wellness
competitors.siteTake: Nurse-led wellness studio hybrid; warm unhurried brand.
competitors.suggestion: Use as Phase 4 vision reference — not this quarter’s homepage promise.

competitors.name: MD Beauty Boston
competitors.siteTake: Personal NP story site; consult-led boutique.
competitors.suggestion: Story length works when authentic — keep Jenny’s story tight and proof-heavy.

competitors.name: Essentially Bare
competitors.siteTake: Laser + injectables multi-service, dual-city convenience focus.
competitors.suggestion: Differentiate as specialist injector studio, not full laser mall.

competitors.name: Bella Aesthetics
competitors.siteTake: Luxury-medical blend; neurotoxins/fillers with natural-radiance language.
competitors.suggestion: Match their calm luxury photography quality; win on ultrasound education.

competitors.name: Aida Medical Aesthetics
competitors.siteTake: New-age luxury NP brand; witty voice; broad injectable menu.
competitors.suggestion: Voice can be warm without gimmicks — keep Angel Face clinical-warm, not quirky.

competitors.name: LaserAway Somerville
competitors.siteTake: National chain template; free consults; promo/SEO machine.
competitors.suggestion: Never race their pricing. Position as anti-chain: one expert, mapped face, natural results.

competitors.name: Enhance Aesthetics
competitors.siteTake: Boutique NP injector; inclusion/authenticity story; simple services list.
competitors.suggestion: North Shore neighbor set — beat on regenerative + ultrasound proof points.

competitors.name: PBinJect Medical Spa
competitors.siteTake: RN injector bio-forward; safety + natural results; education emphasis.
competitors.suggestion: Same category as Jenny — website must feel more premium and more specific (ultrasound).

competitors.name: Infinite Beauty Med Spa
competitors.siteTake: RN-led; PRP/PRF/threads/peptides sprawling menu.
competitors.suggestion: Avoid menu sprawl on homepage. Ladder regenerative carefully so focus stays clear.

competitors.name: MD Esthetics Boston
competitors.siteTake: Multi-location polished; evidence-based + Book Now everywhere.
competitors.suggestion: Adopt persistent Book CTA pattern; keep boutique single-expert personality.

competitors.name: SkinMD
competitors.siteTake: Scale brand; peptides/wellness expansion; master injector framing.
competitors.suggestion: Scale messaging is their game. Yours is depth with Jenny + Stoneham convenience.

competitors.name: SkinHealth Centers
competitors.siteTake: Legacy Newbury flagship; physician aesthetician team; injectable catalog.
competitors.suggestion: Catalog pages are fine later — homepage should sell the wedge offer first.

competitors.name: Skin Laundry
competitors.siteTake: Productized laser facial brand; retail UX; membership energy.
competitors.suggestion: Learn membership/productization later; do not copy laser-first identity.

competitors.name: Medical Aesthetics on Tremont
competitors.siteTake: High-rated local clinic; services-forward booking.
competitors.suggestion: Strong local SEO reminder — keep GBP + service pages sharp for Stoneham.

competitors.name: Icon MD Medical Spa
competitors.siteTake: Laser + spa hybrid; high review volume; multi-service.
competitors.suggestion: Volume brands win on ads. Angel Face wins on named expertise and safety theater (ultrasound).

competitors.name: SIMMETRIA MedSpa
competitors.siteTake: Booking/shopping integrated; wellness + aesthetics.
competitors.suggestion: Integrate booking tightly; shopping secondary to consult CTA.

competitors.name: Self CenteRx
competitors.siteTake: Wellness/medspa hybrid branding; self-care framing.
competitors.suggestion: Self-care language is overused — prefer safety + regenerative specificity.

competitors.name: Boston Beautox

competitors.suggestion: Name clarity helps SEO — protect Angel Face search while adding regenerative keywords.

competitors.name: DeluxeBar Medical Aesthetics
competitors.siteTake: Bar-aesthetic playful luxury; social-first vibe.
competitors.suggestion: Playful can undercut clinical trust — keep Angel Face calm and expert.

competitors.name: ALDA Aesthetics
competitors.siteTake: Rebrand case study: neutrals + pink, mega-menu, conversion copy.
competitors.suggestion: Study their mega-menu IA when you rebuild services navigation.

competitors.name: VIO Med Spa Burlington
competitors.siteTake: Franchise template; promotions; standardized look.
competitors.suggestion: Franchise sameness is your opportunity — look unmistakably Jenny.

competitors.name: The Klinic (ultrasound-capable peers)
competitors.siteTake: Advanced regenerative / facial ultrasound adjacent positioning in market chatter.
competitors.suggestion: If peers claim ultrasound, Angel Face must show proof: process photos, FAQ, consult mapping CTA.
